list: 55 trophies as reported 2026-11-18 (Push Square via Exophase; see Sources note in the app)

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the Platinum: it pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is no separate task to do for it. Work through the roadmap stages in order — story, stranger strands, activities, collectibles, then the 100% cleanup — and this is the last trophy you will hear. Expect a long hunt: published guides put the Platinum at roughly 200 hours (OutputLag).
trophies.source: KeenGamer GTA 6 trophy guide; OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing to the end. It is the first story mission, so this trophy is unmissable as long as you finish the mission — just follow the on-screen objectives until the mission-complete screen appears. No extra objective is needed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1. Chapter trophies unlock automatically when the chapter's final mission ends. Before you start Chapter 1, make a manual save: GTA VI is reported to have no mission replay, so a save at each chapter start is your safety net (OutputLag).
trophies.source: KeenGamer GTA 6 trophy guide; OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2. This is when both protagonists become playable, which opens up most of the side activities, so use the chapter to try activities as they appear. Make a manual save when the chapter starts, since there is reportedly no mission replay (OutputLag).
trophies.source: KeenGamer GTA 6 trophy guide; OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3. Like the other chapter trophies it unlocks on its own when the chapter ends. Keep your manual chapter-start save habit going, and clear any stranger strands that opened up before moving on, so the side content does not pile up for the endgame.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4. This is the last chapter trophy before the finale, so it is a good moment to check your tracker: stranger strands, activities and collectibles found so far should be ticked off here, leaving only the final mission and the cleanup for stage 5.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. It is one of only two Gold trophies in the list. Before you start it, make a manual save — published guides recommend a save before the final mission because there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus reported (OutputLag). Then play the mission through to its ending cutscene.
trophies.source: KeenGamer GTA 6 trophy guide; OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Mission trophies unlock when the mission ends, so follow the objectives and finish it — no optional goal is attached to the trophy itself. If you want to be safe with the reported lack of mission replay, keep a manual save from the start of the chapter it sits in.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions in GTA games usually have a setup phase and then the job itself; the trophy pops when the mission-complete screen shows. Stock up on armour and ammo before the job starts, and play it through in one go.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. As with the other mission trophies, finishing the mission is the whole requirement. The mission name suggests a family-linked job, so expect it to unlock as the story reaches that thread — just keep playing the story and it will come.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Finish the mission and the trophy unlocks at the mission-complete screen. The stylised title points to a music-scene job; there is no extra condition beyond completing it.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, set around Vice City International Airport. Finish the mission objectives through to the end and the trophy pops. Note the related free-roam trophy Catch Me If You Can, which is also about leaving VCIA — that one is a separate stunt, not this mission.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. The name suggests a big set-piece operation, so go in prepared — full health and armour, and a stocked weapon wheel — then play it through to the mission-complete screen for the trophy.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion on the in-game checklist — the second Gold trophy and the hardest one in the list (KeenGamer). The checklist is the long tail: story, stranger strands, activities, collectibles and the other trophies on this page. Use this guide's tracker as your checklist and save the grind trophies (250 stunts, 100 WAiNK scans, 100 vehicles) for this final stage.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts across Leonida — jumps, near misses, airtime and similar driving feats, tracked by the game's counter. The fastest way is to chain stunt jumps and long airtime off ramps and hills in free roam; each successful stunt adds to the count. Treat it as a background grind while you explore for the collectibles, and check the counter in the pause menu.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once — one go at each is enough, you do not have to win or master any of them. The activities include the ones on this list: shooting range, drone racing, racing, fishing, arcade games, bowling, meditation, hunting and stunt driving. Work down the list and tick each off in the tracker as you try it.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Visit the shooting range, pick a challenge, and beat its gold score or time. Work through the weapon categories one at a time and repeat a challenge until the gold medal shows — there is no penalty for retrying. Expect this to take a focused session or two.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location hosts its own race; you need a win at every one, not just one win. Learn each course's racing line on a first attempt, then go for the win — drone races reward smooth cornering over raw speed. Tick locations off in the tracker as you win them.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — the word different matters, so replays of the same race do not count twice. Enter the race events scattered around Leonida (street, off-road and water races are all in play) and win each one once. Pick the fastest vehicle class for the race type and use the racing line; 20 wins across the map is a few evenings of racing.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find the fishing spot, take the challenge against Cal, and out-fish him — cast where the fish are showing, keep tension steady on the line, and reel in smoothly. If you lose, challenge him again; fishing challenges can be retried.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — play any arcade cabinet through to its end. Head to an arcade, pick the cabinet you like best, and finish a full game. This is one of the quickest trophies on the list and counts toward the 9 activity types for Master of None, so do it early.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand through to his final mission. Stranger strands unlock as you meet characters around Leonida — look for their markers on the map and play each mission they offer in order. Andy's last mission is the one that pops this trophy.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand through to his final mission. Play each Kenton mission in order as it appears on the map; the trophy unlocks when the last one ends. The title hints at a boat, so expect at least one mission on the water — keep a fast boat in mind when the strand opens up.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand through to his final mission. The name points to a lone biker, so expect bike-based missions in this strand. Play them in order as they appear; the trophy pops at the end of Billy's last mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. The named strands on this list — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone — are five of them, so find three more stranger characters on the map and finish their strands too. Strangers appear as map markers as the story progresses, so sweep each region as it opens and clear strands before the finale.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand through to his final mission. The title suggests supply runs, so expect delivery-style jobs. Play Randy's missions in order as they appear on the map; the trophy unlocks when the last one is done.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand through to his final mission. Play his missions in order as they appear; the trophy pops at the end of the last one. Like the other stranger strands, this counts toward the 8 strands needed for Strangers & Freaks, so tick both off together.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida — and do the Chapter 1 spot FIRST. This is the list's one reported missable trophy: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 disappears after that chapter, and GTA VI is reported to have no mission replay (OutputLag, KeenGamer). So in Chapter 1, find the balcony meditation spot and use it before the chapter ends. The other 17 spots can be done any time in free roam; use the in-game map markers and tick each spot off here.
trophies.source: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list; KeenGamer GTA 6 trophy guide

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Meet Bret, take his hunting request, then track the unique animal in the wild — follow the tracks and clues the game gives, move quietly, and take a clean shot. Unique animals are one-off hunts, so bring a scoped rifle and approach downwind.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida — in shops, interiors and out-of-the-way spots. Pick up every card you pass while doing other stages, and save the set-completion sweep for stage 4, when you can work region by region with a checklist. Each finished set counts; you need three of them.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app to scan at 100 locations across Leonida. WAiNK is the in-game scanning app — open it at landmarks, businesses and points of interest and scan each one. Do it as you travel for other trophies so the count builds passively, then sweep the map region by region for the last few. The game tracks which locations you have scanned.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges from the game's challenge lists — the assorted small goals tracked in the pause menu (driving, combat, exploration and activity challenges). Work through the easiest ones first: short, repeatable challenges stack up fast, and many complete themselves while you hunt the other trophies. Check the challenge menu regularly to see what is close to done.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Do it when both protagonists are together in free roam: cause chaos in a quiet area until four stars show, then break line of sight, switch to a fast car and stay out of the search cones until the stars clear. Doing it with your partner present is the requirement — solo does not count.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without your wanted level dropping in between. Pick three shops close together, rob the first, move straight to the next while the wanted level holds, and repeat for the third. Go in with a fast getaway car parked outside each shop, keep the robberies quick, and do not get arrested or lose the wanted level mid-chain — if it drops, start the chain over.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Getting in and driving a vehicle you have not found before adds it to the count, so variety matters more than mileage: try cars, bikes, boats, trucks and aircraft as you find them, and use the WAiNK app to spot unfamiliar vehicles. Explore all regions and vehicle types — 100 sounds like a lot, but Leonida's traffic covers it fast.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus, the game's slow-motion aiming mode. The easy setup is a firefight with a group of enemies close together: activate Combat Focus, then drop five of them before the meter runs out. A gang shootout or a wanted-level standoff gives you the crowd — use a fast-firing weapon and aim for headshots.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from Vice City International Airport — steal a plane from VCIA and take off without following the airport's script. Drive onto the airfield, grab a plane, and get airborne while the wanted level builds. The name is a nod to the film: the joke is leaving without a ticket, so any plane will do.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get involved with the Rhino tanks — the description is a joke about how hot it gets inside one. Steal a Rhino from the military base or during a high wanted level, climb in, and drive it around; the trophy is about the tank encounter itself. Expect heavy police attention, so save first and pick a moment when you can enjoy the chaos.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: move slowly, stay out of the cameras' and clerks' sightlines, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, leave and try again — a failed attempt does not lock the trophy, so retry until you get a clean run.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Bank vaults are the bigger heist-style robberies — plan each one like a small job: a fast car outside, armour on, and a route away from the cops before you go in. You need five successful vault jobs with a clean escape, so space them out and do not rush the getaway.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida — watch for one, block it or force it to stop, crack it open and take the cash, then lose the wanted level. A sticky bomb on the rear doors is the classic GTA method; the name is a nod to the Blitz Play heist from GTA V.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Drive, fly or sail into every named area on the map until the counter fills. The easiest way is to work through the map region by region in free roam, combining it with the WAiNK scans and vehicle discoveries — by the time you have done those, most areas will already be visited. Check the map for greyed-out regions you have never entered.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Each gang runs its own rackets around Leonida — find their operations on the map, hit one per gang, and get out. Gang territory matters here: expect armed resistance at each hit, so go in with armour and a good weapon, and tick each gang off in the tracker as you clear it.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to a beachfront bar on Ocean Drive, order a drink, and enjoy the view — the trophy is a small moment, not a mission. The ellipsis in the title is a nod to the game's opening, so treat it as a breather between story chapters.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive a car straight through the showroom glass and out the front. Pick a vehicle showroom, get a car inside or drive one in through the window, then floor it out through the glass. It is a one-move stunt, so save first and enjoy the crash.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play a game at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — and follow through on the shot. Go to the alley, start a game of bowling, and finish it; the trophy is about playing the game, not about a perfect score. It also counts as one of the 9 activity types for Master of None. A nod to GTA IV's famous bowling, so take your time with it.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Build a partnership with mass appeal — a hidden trophy whose description gives little away, so the unlock is tied to a story or side moment involving the two protagonists working together. Play the story and the partner activities, and check the published guides (KeenGamer, OutputLag) for the confirmed method once the community pins it down after launch.
trophies.source: KeenGamer GTA 6 trophy guide; OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices — the game tracks them, with a counter that runs up to 500. Story and side content keep offering decisions (who to help, how to handle a job), and each one counts. Just play naturally and make the choices as they come; the counter builds over a full playthrough, so there is nothing to grind here, only decisions to keep making.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try — fail something, then get it right the next attempt. The description points to a retry: fail a challenge, race or mission attempt, then complete it on the next go. It should unlock naturally during play, since everyone fails something eventually; if it has not popped by the endgame, retry any activity you failed earlier and pass it.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange — a hidden-event style trophy for finding one of Leonida's weird encounters. Explore odd corners of the map, especially at night: UFO-style sightings and strange events are a GTA tradition, and this trophy is the game's nod to them. Check the published guides after launch for the confirmed location once players find it.
trophies.source: KeenGamer GTA 6 trophy guide; OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock people over with a melee drive-by — drive past pedestrians and hit them with a melee weapon from the vehicle. The bowling name is the joke: you are the ball. Find a busy sidewalk, drive slowly alongside a group, and swing. It is a dark-humour trophy in the classic GTA style; a quiet street with a few pedestrians is enough.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists; take them to your laundering contacts and convert them into clean cash. It is a slow earner, so keep laundering after every big job and let the total build across the playthrough — it should be close to done by the time you reach the 100% cleanup.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — clothes, weapons, ammo, food, car mods, anything sold in a shop counts toward the total. Spend normally through the story and you will be well on the way; in the endgame, top it up with big purchases like weapon upgrades and vehicle customisation. The tracker in the pause menu shows your running total.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties around Leonida. Garages go on sale as you explore and earn money — buy each one when its for-sale sign appears. They double as storage for your vehicle collection, so buy them as you find them rather than leaving all eight for the endgame; each purchase counts toward the total.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app lets you register vehicles you find — open it, pick a vehicle you own or have discovered, and register it. Ten different vehicles is the target, so register the varied cars and bikes you collect while hunting the 100-vehicle trophy; the two goals overlap nicely.
